latency_breakdown.method: 20 independent HTTPS requests per endpoint from the development PC, plus direct Linode/Uvicorn and PostgreSQL measurements

external_components_typical_ms.note: Independent curl processes intentionally include a fresh TCP/TLS connection. Network conditions varied from the earlier 566-570 ms baseline.

latency_breakdown.fastapi_middleware_and_serialization_est: approximately 1-4 warm; included in direct Uvicorn figures

bottleneck.primary: WAN round trips and fresh TCP/TLS handshakes between Taiwan and the Tokyo Linode
bottleneck.secondary: Large industry peer response transfer; application cache already avoids repeated PostgreSQL work

changes.industry_peer_query: Limit valuation, revenue and health aggregation to the requested industry's stocks before aggregation; no new index
changes.response_cache_reason: FastAPI/DB warm processing is only 2-5 ms for normal endpoints and existing in-process cache already covers stock detail and peers. Nginx caching would add invalidation/staleness complexity without removing WAN RTT.

full_page_same_condition.method: 20 runs from the same development PC; stock detail first, then financials/chips/peers concurrently; new client per run

concurrency_20_requests_200.scope: Direct Uvicorn capacity test on Linode so the intentional public 10 req/s rate limit does not distort backend capacity
concurrency_20_requests_200.note: HTTP/2 does not affect this direct-Uvicorn test; the before/after difference is runtime variation, not attributed to the Nginx change.
